title: Level preset
description: data/presets/<id>.json (V8, A5; YOK-198): how one special looks at one level. A special names its preset per level (levels.1.preset, levels.2.preset, levels.3.evolution.preset); this file says which special and level it is for, and the validator checks the two agree. Presentation only: the sim never reads a preset. A special with no preset file at a level gets the default hit spark, coloured by the move's source (V5). Authored by asset-smith (AM5) once the VFX textures are approved.

special.description: The special (data/moves/<id>.json, kind special) this preset dresses.

colour.description: The move's colour at this level (V8). The hit spark uses it unless spark.colour is set.

spark.description: The hit spark this special makes at this level. Every field is optional; a field left out keeps the default spark's value.

colour.description: Spark tint; left out = the preset's colour.

scale_pct.description: Size against the default spark for the same hit (100 = unchanged).

frames.description: Ticks the spark shows (60 per second, F3); left out = the default (the hit's hitstop plus the fade).

textures.description: Spark images by outcome, paths relative to game/ (e.g. vfx/hit_sparks/foxfire-lv2-hit.png). An outcome left out uses the default spark image for it.

sheet_columns.description: Frames laid side by side in each image (a one-row flipbook played once over the spark's life); 1 = a still image.

tint.description: Multiply the image by the colour (default true: author images white or greyscale). false = show the image's own colours.

projectile.description: YOK-242: how the projectile looks in flight. Drawn over the data hitbox: the drawn quad keeps the box's leading edge and vertical centre, and the look's trail runs back behind it. Left out = an orb in the preset's colour.

colour.description: Fill colour; left out = the preset's colour.

core.description: Inner colour of the two-tone look; left out = rice paper #F1E8D4.

scale_pct.description: Size against the look's default over the hitbox (100 = unchanged).

texture.description: Image relative to game/. Left out = the look's YOK-243 slot under game/assets/generated/vfx/projectiles/ (ink_wave: proj-ink-wave.png, fox_flame: proj-fox-flame.png) when it exists, else the procedural shader.

sheet_columns.description: Frames side by side in the image, looped at 4 ticks a frame; 1 = a still image.

tint.description: Multiply the image by the colour (default true). false = the image's own colours.

cast.description: YOK-242: the effect when the special starts, placed from the caster (trail and ring ride on the caster while the move plays).

release.description: YOK-242: the effect on the release: at the hand when the projectile spawns, else on the special's first active frame.

impact.description: YOK-242: the effect where the special connects (hit, block, projectile clash; a command grab on the grab).

effect.description: YOK-242: one special-move effect. Every field is optional; left out = the default for the move's generic properties (Fight/Vfx/SpecialVfxStyle.cs): cast seal (teleport: afterimage; charge or forward travel: trail; projectile invulnerability: ring); release: the projectile's splash (hits low: dust); impact: splash (command grab: grab; hits low: dust).

look.description: Procedural effect look; none = no effect.

colour.description: Fill colour; left out = the preset's colour.

core.description: Inner colour of the two-tone look; left out = rice paper #F1E8D4.

scale_pct.description: Size against the look's default (100 = unchanged).

frames.description: Ticks the effect shows (60 per second, F3); left out = the look's default (trail and ring: while the move plays).

texture.description: Image relative to game/. Left out = the look's YOK-243 slot under game/assets/generated/vfx/effects/ (seal: fx-seal-burst.png, afterimage: fx-afterimage.png, trail: fx-speed-trail.png, dust: fx-ground-wave.png, grab: fx-water-swirl.png, ring: fx-spin-ring.png) when it exists, else the procedural shader.

sheet_columns.description: Frames side by side in the image, played once over the effect's life; 1 = a still image.

tint.description: Multiply the image by the colour (default true). false = the image's own colours.
